# Product context

Use this skill for product, domain, UX, and architecture decisions.

Trion is a specialist manufacturing digitalisation and operational
transformation consultancy for UK manufacturing SMEs. Its work connects people,
processes, technology, systems, data, and operational performance in real
production, machining, assembly, quality, logistics, planning, maintenance, and
engineering environments.

Fabric is Trion's internal transformation delivery platform. It supports
Discover → Diagnose → Design → Deliver → Measure by capturing structured
context, evidence, analysis, opportunities, initiatives, benefits, and approved
outputs once and reusing them throughout an engagement.

Build for Trion staff, not a public SaaS audience. Fabric is not a generic CRM,
project-management suite, dashboard builder, chatbot, or document store.
Prefer connected structured information over disconnected forms and reports.
The methodology is Understand, Simplify, Standardise, Automate, Measure.

Every decision must preserve the distinction between internal working material
and controlled client-facing content. AI can assist, but important conclusions
remain attributable, evidence-linked, reviewable, and human-approved.
